_weaponClassNote: A blade in each hand. Fast, asymmetric, never a wind-up.
_artNote: Board model built via the Rodin import path (tools/art/rodin_bake_lowpoly.py), not the procedural generator. Full art direction (build/posture/garment/face) still to be written; palette below is sampled from the baked texture for reference.

palette._comment: Sampled from the baked Rodin texture (2026-08-26), not hand-authored. dressPlum is also the blindfold colour (rodin_bake_lowpoly --blindfold-color).

clips._comment: Clip names as they appear in build/.../wisp.glb, normalised by build_glb.py from the Mixamo FBX filenames (lowercase + underscores: 'Wisp Idle.fbx' -> 'wisp_idle'). Ability keys are the ability ids from data/characters/wisp.json; a missing id falls back to idle (character-clips.ts:100). Download each Without Skin, one clip per file, rename to the value here, then run build_glb.py. Mapping is a Designer call (2026-08-26, owner to confirm final clips). Recommended Mixamo source per clip in _source.

_source.wisp_idle: Mixamo 'Ninja Idle' — relaxed, weight on one hip, slow sway. The bored/half-lidded read lives in the portrait (Deliverable A), so a calm idle is enough here. This is the one clip the decoy plays — keep it neutral (ART_PIPELINE.md §8).
_source.wisp_run: Mixamo 'Ninja Run' — light and quick; a phantom does not pound the ground.
_source.wisp_hit: Mixamo 'Standing React Small From Front' — a brief flinch, plays once.
_source.wisp_death: Mixamo 'Falling Back Death' — collapses back and holds the last frame.
_source.knocked_down: Mixamo 'Knocked Down' — SHARED across the roster (aegis uses it too). Download once, reuse.
_source.wisp_flurry: Mixamo 'Knife Attack' (or 'Dual Weapon Combo') — a fast close two-dagger slash for the melee cone. No wind-up.
_source.wisp_bola: Mixamo 'Throw Object' — a single thrown line for the bola.
_source.wisp_blink: Mixamo 'Standing Dodge Backward' trimmed to a crouch-spring. The vanish/reappear itself is VFX (§9); Blink and Shadowstep Strike share that teleport beat.
_source.wisp_veil: Mixamo 'Standing 2H Magic Attack 01' trimmed to a one-handed seal, or a short 'Praying' gesture — a beat as she dissolves. The fade is VFX (§9).
_source.wisp_shadowstep: Mixamo 'Stabbing' (or 'Sword And Shield Slash') — the ultimate strike as she arrives at the aimed square.
